overview_description.description: ALEF Technology is Afghanistan’s leading broadcast technical services and critical power company, providing turnkey end-to-end communication and power solutions to corporate customers. ALEF employs best of class technology infrastructure including high performance satellite uplink and downlink through a long-term partnership with Abu Dhabi-based satellite services provider YahLive, microwave towers and an interactive voice response hardware platform. ALEF’s clients include Afghanistan’s broadcast media companies, Telecom companies, government entities, banks and educational institutions.

product.name: Playout Solutions
product.description: A cloud-based managed service for broadcasting TV channels, handling content scheduling, asset management, graphics, and delivery to satellite and OTT platforms.

product.name: Satellite & Teleport Services
product.description: Satellite uplink and downlink services for TV and radio channels, including signal encoding, multiplexing, encryption, and modulation across various frequency bands.

product.name: Technology Services
product.description: Data center hosting, co-location, disaster recovery, IT equipment supply, software development, cybersecurity, cloud hosting, and content delivery network services.

product.name: Telephony and Value-Added Services (VAS)
product.description: Telephony solutions including call center, IVR, SMS, IP PBX, and integrated communication platforms for businesses and broadcasters.
